Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- What you asked for: evidence on audit logs, retention controls, and an initial SLA outline.
- Next meeting ask: technical deep dive + security Q&A (we'll bring our security engineer) and a short procurement sync if that works for you.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue May 18, 10:00–10:45 AM PST
- Wed May 19, 2:00–2:45 PM PST

If neither works, tell me two 45-minute windows that do; we can also do a split cadence (30m demo + 15m procurement).

Also: can you loop in the primary security and procurement contacts so we have the right people on the invite? If helpful I can include our security lead (Marissa Cole) and platform engineer (Karthik Iyer) on the thread.

Attached: draft mutual action plan (lightweight) and a one-pager on our hosting modes — will update after your inputs.

Thanks,
